title: Camp Leonard, 1863
text: Camp Leonard was established at Weldon in the late summer of 1863 by a company of the 2nd California Volunteer Cavalry, to protect the region's mining camps. Some 850 Native people from the Owens Valley had left the Sebastian Indian Reservation because of the scarcity of food there, all intent on returning to their former homes. The camp stayed in operation for the rest of that year.
